chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqteen, from his brother Al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Yaqteen, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): Is the girl married off while she is three years old, or is the boy married off while he is three years old, and what is the minimum age at which they are married? And when the girl reaches puberty/maturity and does not consent, what is her status? He said: 'There is no harm in that if her father or her guardian consents.'
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum age for child marriage in Shia jurisprudence and what is the role of the girl's consent upon maturity?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) establishes the permissibility of *nikah* (marriage contract) for young children as early as age three, provided their father or guardian consents. It highlights the Shia jurisprudential distinction between the validity of the initial contract and the girl's right to exercise *khiyar al-bulugh* (option of maturity) to annul it upon reaching puberty if she withholds her consent.
